integrity: A complete self-contained proof and a standalone finite coefficient checker are embedded; finite checks are not substituted for infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Four generators in arithmetic progression; a>=4, d>=1, gcd(a,d)=1; only third threshold and the associated low-multiplicity gap count. Priority is subject to unindexed literature.
title: Third Frobenius thresholds and low-multiplicity genus for four-term arithmetic progressions
